description:
Proposal: /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-gl6.18.html (approved 2026-11-11), step 2.

Change:
- fz_aot_setup samples the block pool before creating main's process; if FZ_LOG_TELEMETRY names a path it opens it create+append (so a log fz2 --log-telemetry ... build just wrote keeps its compile events first). An open failure is loud: stderr + non-zero exit, never a silent run without the log.
- AotScheduler::observe writes each event with the runtime write_line as one unbuffered write (whole lines only); time_ns counts from fz_aot_setup; span ids 0. Unset variable: no file, one branch per event.
- fz_aot_run_main observes ExecutionReady before its loop and RunEnded after the scheduler drops. The binary does not write FZ_EXEC_READY_FD (build leg deadline is ExecutionBoundary::Spawn).
- tests/fixture_matrix.rs run_path_logged_to(Build): after fz2 --log-telemetry build, run the binary with FZ_LOG_TELEMETRY = same log path and the fixture's args; compile failures start no binary.
- build joins every runtime-telemetry pin that loops over run and interp (fixtures 00901, 00902, 00903, 00906, 00907, 00910, 00911); new pin: 00687 emits exactly one scheduler_slept on build (count only); new parity test: build's probe sequence (outcome, receiver, gift_bytes, gift_blocks), gc anatomy (pid, boundary, copied_bytes) and per-pid dtors_dispatched equal run's.

Prediction: build equals run on all of it (00910: 50 misses of 80, 1 hit of 48, 49 misses of 80, 7968 total; 00911: empty hit then 8 hits of 320016; 00901: 8 collections, 1804848 bytes copied); dtors 1 (00906) and 3 (00907); run_ended before == after; 00687 slept = 1. A build/run difference is a finding: stop and diagnose, never re-pin.

Cost check, reported in the commit (not pinned): built binary size before/after for one fixture; release timing of 00910/00911 binaries with the variable unset, same machine, before vs after, exit codes checked; predicted no difference beyond noise.

Done when: the above; runtime-telemetry.md gains a built-binary section and every "carries no telemetry bus" sentence and "pins on run and interp" list is rewritten to the present fact; performance-instrumentation.md shows how to log a built binary; the no-bus comment in aot_shim.rs is gone; grep over .agent, guides, README.md confirms; full gate green (cargo fmt --all -- --check; cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings; cargo test --workspace --all-targets --no-fail-fast -- --test-threads=1; cargo test --workspace --doc); commit in Why / What changed / Verification form; no co-author trailer, no attribution line.
title: A built binary writes runtime telemetry to FZ_LOG_TELEMETRY, and every runtime pin covers build
